name: Supporting Working Carers
organisation: Carers Count Kirklees (delivered by Cloverleaf Advocacy)
whoFor: Kirklees employers supporting staff who have unpaid caring responsibilities, and working carers themselves (supported through their employer).
locations: Online - 30-minute awareness sessions and one-to-one Teams calls
In person - employer forums (e.g. The Zone, Huddersfield) and employer drop-ins
On site at employer premises by arrangement
eligibility: Employers and organisations in Kirklees - managers, HR teams, mental health first aiders and anyone supporting staff wellbeing - who want to identify, engage, support and retain unpaid carers
Employees with unpaid caring responsibilities at risk of reducing hours or leaving work are supported indirectly through their employer
referralRoutes: Online booking for awareness sessions, training and forums (Eventbrite)

selfReferral.note: Yes - employers can register directly via any route

projects.name: Employer awareness training
projects.overview: A 30-minute online session on supporting employees who care, and to meet the team.
projects.duration: 30 minutes, repeating dates through the year

projects.name: One-to-one employer support
projects.overview: A one-to-one Teams call, then tailored support to identify carers in the workforce and put practical policies and culture in place.

projects.name: Employer forums
projects.overview: Quarterly forums for peer learning and awareness raising.

projects.name: Employer training session
projects.overview: Free online training on legal duties and carers' rights, recognising and supporting carers, reducing discrimination risk and managing flexible working.
projects.duration: 90 minutes, repeating dates through the year

notes: Status before November 2026: Live - open to referrals

provenance.evidence: Provider page checked 5 Nov 2026 (sessions listed to Nov 2026) and matches Pathways v2.1; programme manager confirmed it is current, on-site delivery, both contact emails and that everything is free.
